prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 3x3 editorial contact sheet with consistent subject, outfit, room, and soft natural light.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long wavy dark brown hair, natural makeup, relaxed expressions, a light neutral strapless or thin-strap top, high-waisted blue jeans, and a large bouquet of fresh pink tulips with long green stems and leaves.
prompt.composition_elements: Square 3x3 grid with thin white dividers, same beige wall and same light throughout. Include varied three-quarter, side, back, playful lean, close-up bouquet, and seated/standing crop poses while preserving the same adult subject, outfit, bouquet, and visual continuity. No text anywhere.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft window daylight with gentle bounce, calm minimal editorial mood, soft neutral beige wall, pastel pink flowers, natural skin texture, subtle filmic contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: 1:1 square, full-frame DSLR look, 50mm prime, f/2.8, crisp but natural focus, minimal distortion, very subtle 35mm grain, natural filmic dynamic range, ultra-high-resolution editorial contact sheet.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 3x3 editorial contact sheet featuring the same adult woman with long wavy dark brown hair, natural makeup, relaxed expressions, a light neutral strapless or thin-strap top, high-waisted blue jeans, and a large bouquet of fresh pink tulips with long green stems and leaves in front of a plain beige wall. Same room, same soft window daylight, same outfit, and consistent palette across every panel. Include three-quarter, side profile, back pose, playful lean, close-up bouquet, and varied crop poses. Square 1:1 layout with thin white dividers, full-frame DSLR look, 50mm prime, f/2.8, crisp natural focus, very subtle 35mm grain, calm minimal editorial mood, no text anywhere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, inconsistent identity, different outfit between panels, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry, low quality, distorted features, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, clutter, unwanted text, logo, watermark

assets.name: adult tulip contact-sheet subject
assets.usage: Preserve the same approved adult identity, face, hair, and expression continuity across all nine panels.

assets.name: plain beige wall

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the preview to lock the nine-panel layout, adult identity, outfit, bouquet, backdrop, and light. Preserve consistency across panels; only poses and crops vary. Person, wardrobe, flowers, and background can be replaced independently only with equivalent non-branded references. Typography must remain absent.
